{"created": "2026-11-20T18:40:55.603676+00:00", "modified": "2026-11-20T18:40:56.051673+00:00", "id": 24395871, "conceptrecid": "24395870", "doi": "10.5281/zenodo.24395871", "conceptdoi": "10.5281/zenodo.24395870", "doi_url": "https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24395871", "metadata": {"title": "ECI candidate photos: 2024 Lok Sabha and state assemblies, November 2023 to May 2026", "doi": "10.5281/zenodo.24395871", "publication_date": "2026-11-20", "description": "

Photographs of 36,122 candidates in India's 2024 Lok Sabha election and in every state assembly election from November 2023 to May 2026, as the Election Commission of India (ECI) showed them on its results website, each matched to the candidate's row in in-rolls/eci_results on its six-column key (State_Name, Year, month, Poll_No, Constituency_No, Position).

\n

This record is a snapshot of in-rolls/eci_candidate_photos at commit 3f9ddb2. The photos are in one zip per election (photos_<election>.zip; one JPEG per candidate, byte for byte as ECI served it, 1.8 GB in all). code_and_data.zip holds data/eci_results_join.csv (the join), data/coverage.csv (seats and candidates with and without a photo, by election and state), data/manifest.csv (each photo's URL, source, retrieval time, SHA-256, size and pixel dimensions), the archived candidate pages, and the code that collected, matched and audited them. Unzipping every file into one folder rebuilds the repository. The README describes the method and the gaps: 3,654 November 2023 candidates whose seat pages the Internet Archive never saved, and 12 Karanpur by-poll candidates whose photos sit on an ECI server that stopped answering.

\n

The code is under the MIT license. The photographs were published by ECI; this record claims no rights in them. Many of the people pictured are private citizens; please do not use the photographs to identify or profile individuals.
